terms.gloss: a little seat: a child’s car seat
terms.comment: Our use: no reference work has a word for a child’s car seat. Classically sellula is a little seat (Lewis & Short); in full, sellula puerīlis. The straps are the seat belt, cinctūra sēcūritātis (Traupman 218).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 218, checked against the searchable text of the book (11 November 2026).
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
